subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving funded accounts for your wallet in South Africa. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the funded account itself, the first money-in with the wallet loaded, and read it back through an S2S postback off your platform held through the FICA and first-load window, so a registered-but-empty install never bills as a fund. At scale that lands an eCPA on the funded account near R190. If it helps, I can pull the funded-account read for your live geos. Worth a quick look?
angle: warm bump, restate funded-account validation proof
illustrative_flags: eCPA on the funded account near R190 (MobUpps-specific, illustrative placeholder)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN fintech wallet: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof from parent (funded-account optimization + S2S postback held through FICA/first-load validation window); one illustrative figure (eCPA R190); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; native en, no transliteration; no sign-off; no em dash; no X-not-Y comma-negation.
